questions.q: What did CBS do during the 2008 recession to reverse its falling viewership?
a: It aired solution-focused stories during a Happy Week
It replaced anchors with comedy performers
It stopped reporting on the economy entirely
It moved all its news online for a year
questions.why: Lesson 1 describes CBS's Happy Week, when anchors shared news with a focus on solutions, after which viewership exceeded the previous year.

questions.q: What surprised researchers in Ellen Langer's study of older men?
a: Their strength, memory and even eyesight improved
They became more aware of their real age
Their health declined from the vivid stories
Only their memory scores showed any change
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the 75-year-olds who lived as if 20 years younger improved on every measure, including eyesight, after just a week.

questions.q: What happened to people primed with positive words in the Stanford study?
a: They behaved more kindly and cooperated more
They finished the language test much faster
They became more impatient with the researcher
They forgot the words they had just seen
questions.why: Lesson 2 says the group shown words like calm and respectful acted cooperatively, while the negative group interrupted more.

questions.q: Which mental exercise helped students perform better on an exam?
a: Thinking about the traits of a brilliant professor
Imagining themselves as a rebellious hooligan
Recalling a recent failure in detail
Discussing the test with anxious classmates
questions.why: Lesson 2 says participants primed with thoughts of a brilliant professor scored higher than those told to think of a hooligan.

questions.q: What are the four C's used to help someone through a hard time?
a: Capital, context, compassion and commitment
Courage, calm, clarity and consistency
Curiosity, candor, care and control
Connection, conversation, comfort and change
questions.why: Lesson 3 lists social capital, context, compassion and commitment as the steps for listening supportively without encouraging negativity.
